# Laya-Plus docs (llms.txt)

Laya-Plus: open self-hosted System-1 decision model.
state + typed questions -> calibrated choice / score / noul probabilities. No text generation.

Pages (relative links):
- Introduction: index.html — System One, checkpoints, Jev targets
- Quick start: quickstart.html — pip install + 20-line Router example
- Primitives: primitives.html — State, Choice, Score, Noul, parallel single-pass, Confidence
- Routing: routing.html — Router, route precedence, script detection, preload, task opt-in
- Long context: long-context.html — retrieve-then-decide wrapper + stage-B Aggregator (32k)
- Patterns: patterns.html — confidence-gated routing, shortlist coarse-to-fine,
  retrieve-then-decide, example use cases
- Python API: api.html — Router / Agent / LongContextRouter / chunk utils /
  Aggregator / shortlist / eval harness signatures
- Benchmarks + targets: benchmarks.html — Jev 1.13.0 targets
  (td 0.727 / ag 0.910 / emo 0.480 / b77 0.870 / ECE 0.246); measured = TBD

Unofficial community fork, not affiliated with ConvAI Innovations or TypeSafe AI.
Enhanced by Kotala Kishan Reddy.
